content.comment_body: Hello! I'm trying to establish a connection between my [product_name] and [version_no], but there seems to be an issue with communication when [product_name] is set as the client. Any assistance would be appreciated. Here is the error I encountered.
It appears you haven't enabled the PUT/GET communication setting.
There is also an application example from [company_name]: [product_name] - Connection using [product_name] as Client and [version_no] as Server.
It seems that the [product_name] [version_no] now includes this specific setting.

In the provided folder named "LOGOCOM," there is one network project file (with .snp extension) featuring a [product_name] [version_no] as the device. The S7 access is permitted in this configuration.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble setting up communication between a [product_name] controller configured as a client and a [version_no] PLC. The issue is traced to the PUT/GET communication setting not being enabled on the PLC, which is essential for data transfer. Suggestions include checking documentation and example projects, and noting that [product_name] [version_no] supports the necessary setting.
